parts.text: What can he correctly conclude about mass?

options.text: The steel nail has more mass than the foam piece.
The steel nail has more volume than the foam piece because it is heavier.
The foam piece has more mass because it looks larger.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Qasim places a small steel nail and a large foam packing piece on a balance. The steel nail is heavier than the foam piece. The foam piece looks larger.

part_answers.answer: Heavier on the balance means greater mass; looking larger does not decide mass.

teacher.key_rationale: On a balance, the heavier object has more mass. Apparent size is not the same as mass.
